# Agent image vectors

📌 **TL;DR:** shared cases for the agent image check in Go, Python and TypeScript. `cases.json` maps each file to its sniffed type and side, or to the words its refusal contains. Tests make the over-256-KiB case themselves, so no large file is committed.

The rules are in [agent images](../../../Plans/R1.1/agent-images.md#rules).
